use.flag: Install the 50stratis sys-kernel/dracut module, which assembles a Stratis pool in a systemd initramfs so the root filesystem can live on Stratis
Install the systemd units, the stratis-fstab-setup helper and the systemd generators, and build stratisd-min, stratis-min and stratis-utils with sd_notify() support (links sys-apps/systemd)

pkgmetadata.longdescription: stratisd is the daemon of Stratis, a local storage management system that builds pools from block devices on top of device-mapper thin provisioning and XFS, with snapshots, optional LUKS2 encryption and a cache tier. It is controlled over D-Bus. The package also ships stratisd-min and stratis-min, a JSON-RPC daemon and client for early boot, the udev helpers that name /dev/stratis links, and maintenance tools such as stratis-dumpmetadata and stratis-predict-usage.
